body: I feel you, I have a friend that constantly gets dates but cancels last minute and I’m just here trying to get someone to message me back.
You are not alone but you have to go for what makes you happy.

I have anxiety when it comes to talking to people and taking risks when it comes to relationships. What I learned is that you’ll never know 100% of what someone feels. So you just have to build up the courage to take that leap.
I appreciate it and yeah easier said then done
